projects.title: VaultIQ

projects.responsibility: Full-stack development, database design, and CI/CD setup.
projects.evidence: Achieved 100% asset reconciliation accuracy and reduced audit time from days to hours.

projects.title: Forex Ensemble Prediction
projects.description: Ensemble machine learning project applying Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and stacking to forecast Forex movements.
projects.problem: Single models often overfit to historical forex data, leading to poor generalization in live prediction.
projects.responsibility: Data preprocessing, model stacking architecture, and backtesting framework.
projects.evidence: Improved directional accuracy by 12% over baseline models through ensemble stacking.
